cases.title: Models and transactions

Example 1

from sqlalchemy import create_engine, text
engine = create_engine("sqlite://", future=False)
with engine.begin() as connection:
    result = connection.execute(text("SELECT 1"))
cases.rationale: An explicit legacy Engine with text and a managed transaction supports Connection.execute on SQLAlchemy1.4.

cases.title: Models and transactions
cases.source:
Commit as you go

from sqlalchemy import create_engine, text
engine = create_engine("sqlite://", future=False)
with engine.connect() as connection:
    connection.execute(text("INSERT INTO example VALUES (1)"))
    connection.commit()
cases.rationale: Connection.commit is not the legacy1.4 API; explicit commit placement alone cannot establish compatibility.
